headline: The windsock finally has cloth
lede: Slot b resumed #3370 mid-sweep after a dead session and shipped the SKYWARD strip polish: a rippling three-joint windsock, two-way painted numbers, a live-zone ladder banner, earned dust plumes, and dusk contrast measured in pixels instead of assumed.

notes.text: A dead lane was caught mid-mutant-sweep on #3370 — tree clean, PR up, kill-count unproven. The resume re-proved every gate (194 pins, all mutants, browser pass) before merging: an interrupted sweep is never trusted for its claimed result.
The windsock tail is now three hinged joints whose flutter lags 0.09 s each, so a gust snap travels DOWN the fabric like cloth instead of snapping as one rigid arrow.
A wheels-abort rolling east→west now reads upright numbers: the south lane carries a faint mirrored ladder, and the painted decal, ▸ banner and scoring all agree on the same zone.
Vite dev servers survive their sessions and squat their slot's port — scripts/devstop.sh (kill-by-port, never pkill -f) freed :5178 of the dead session's server in one line.
